lines.text: Playgrounds need cushioned floors. Can a scrap tyre become one?
lines.tts: Playgrounds need cushioned floors. Can a scrap tire become one?
lines.phonemes: plˈeɪɡɹaʊndz nˈiːd kˈʊʃənd flˈɔːɹz. kæn ɐ skɹˈæp tˈaɪɚ bɪkˈʌm wˌʌn?

lines.text: Crumb rubber already goes into playground floors and tiles.
lines.phonemes: kɹˈʌm ɹˈʌbɚɹ ɔːlɹˌɛdi ɡoʊz ˌɪntʊ plˈeɪɡɹaʊnd flˈɔːɹz ænd tˈaɪlz.

lines.text: Shred tyres, pull steel with magnets, blow off fibre, sieve the crumb.
lines.tts: Shred tires, pull steel with magnets, blow off fiber, sieve the crumb.
lines.phonemes: ʃɹˈɛd tˈaɪɚz, pˈʊl stˈiːl wɪð mˈæɡnɪts, blˈoʊ ˈɔf fˈaɪbɚ, sˈɪv ðə kɹˈʌm.

lines.text: Mix the crumb with a binder and press it into tiles.
lines.phonemes: mˈɪks ðə kɹˈʌm wɪð ɐ bˈaɪndɚ ænd pɹˈɛs ɪɾ ˌɪntʊ tˈaɪlz.

lines.text: Say fifty tyres make a hundred tiles that sell for ₹35,000.
lines.tts: Say fifty tires make a hundred tiles that sell for thirty-five thousand rupees.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪ fˈɪfti tˈaɪɚz mˌeɪk ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd tˈaɪlz ðæt sˈɛl fɔːɹ θˈɜːɾifˈaɪv θˈaʊzənd ɹˈuːpiːz.

lines.text: After crumb, binder, labour and press costs, about ₹9,000 is left.
lines.tts: After crumb, binder, labor and press costs, about nine thousand is left.
lines.phonemes: ˈæftɚ kɹˈʌm, bˈaɪndɚ, lˈeɪbɚɹ ænd pɹˈɛs kˈɔsts, ɐbˌaʊt nˈaɪn θˈaʊzənd ɪz lˈɛft.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
